kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
اؤتمنت (form VIII)
# اُؤْتُمِنْتُ (uʔtumintu) /uʔ.tu.min.tu/: first-person singular past passive of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# اُؤْتُمِنْتَ (uʔtuminta) /uʔ.tu.min.ta/: second-person masculine singular past passive of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# اُؤْتُمِنْتِ (uʔtuminti) /uʔ.tu.min.ti/: second-person feminine singular past passive of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# اُؤْتُمِنَتْ (uʔtuminat) /uʔ.tu.mi.nat/: third-pe
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
